corpusChunks.content: Project-only synthetic demo policy; not regulations or Core-native truth. For ruleCode SYNTH_LIMIT, currency USD, SYNTH_OPERATOR GTE, and SYNTH_THRESHOLD 100.00, currentAmount at or above 100.00 yields CONFIRMED; below 100.00 yields IGNORED. Required evidence cites documentId=synth-usd-limit, version=v1, sectionPath=Document and an exact relevant excerpt. Any missing or wrong prerequisite, absent exact policy citation, or missing/unparseable currentAmount yields INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Amounts are exact decimal strings; never round across the boundary. 中文：仅项目合成规则，美元金额大于等于100.00确认，小于100.00忽略；规则、币种、GTE、阈值100.00及精确政策引用缺一或错误均证据不足。

Project-only synthetic demo workflow; not regulations. A reviewer claims a pending manual audit before recording a decision. The record includes reviewer identity, review time, decision and reason, with evidence references when available. A second reviewer cannot overwrite a completed decision; corrections create a linked follow-up record. An abandoned claim can be released for reassignment. Escalate unresolved evidence to the audit lead; never mark it completed just to clear the queue. 中文：人工审核先认领后填写结论和原因；已完成结论的更正保留原记录并关联后续记录。

Project-only synthetic demo policy; not regulations. ACTIVE accounts can submit ordinary demo operations. SUSPENDED accounts cannot submit new operations until a reviewer records a reinstatement reason and changes the state to ACTIVE. CLOSED accounts remain read-only for historical lookup; reopening is outside this policy. A state review records the prior state, new state, actor, time and reason. An appeal alone does not lift a suspension. 中文：暂停账户须审核记录恢复原因并改为ACTIVE后才能新增操作；关闭账户仅供历史查询。

Project-only synthetic operational policy; not regulations, a legal retention schedule, or a production promise. Keep demo diagnostic logs for 30 days and temporary export files for 7 days, then delete them during the next scheduled cleanup. A documented investigation hold pauses cleanup for the identified artifacts until the owner releases it. Record cleanup runs and failures. These periods do not define retention for business records or personal data in production. 中文：演示诊断日志保留30天，临时导出保留7天；调查保留标记暂停相关清理，解除后恢复。

Project-only synthetic demo policy; not regulations. This separate rule is EUR_LIMIT for currency EUR, operator GTE and threshold 80.00. A valid EUR_LIMIT case at or above 80.00 is queued for euro specialist review; below 80.00 is not queued. Cite documentId=euro-review, version=v1, sectionPath=Document with an exact excerpt. This policy cannot establish SYNTH_LIMIT, a USD threshold, or a USD CONFIRMED/IGNORED outcome. 中文：EUR_LIMIT只处理欧元，金额达到80.00进入欧元专员复核；不得用作美元合成限额规则的证据。

Project-only synthetic demo procedure; not regulations. Reconcile a settlement by comparing its business reference, currency and amount against the ledger entry. A missing entry, currency mismatch or amount mismatch opens a discrepancy for operations review. Repeating the same settlement event must not create another ledger entry. Mark reconciliation complete only after a matching entry or an approved correction is recorded; merely receiving a settlement event is insufficient. 中文：按业务编号、币种、金额核对结算与账本；重复事件不新增账本记录，差异须处理后才能完成对账。

Project-only synthetic demo support guidance; not regulations. For a failed demo request, provide the request identifier, approximate failure time, visible error and steps to reproduce. Do not include passwords, access tokens or full payment-card numbers. A request identifier helps support find the diagnostic record; opening a ticket does not retry an operation or prove it succeeded. If no identifier is shown, describe the screen and action that failed. 中文：报障提供请求编号、时间、错误和复现步骤；工单本身不代表操作成功，也不会触发重试。

Project-only synthetic demo infrastructure runbook; not regulations. When the message queue is unavailable, the database remains the business record and pending outbox entries wait for delivery. Restore queue connectivity, then inspect publisher retries and the pending backlog. Consumers must tolerate duplicate deliveries through business idempotency. Declare recovery after connectivity returns and the backlog drains without new delivery errors; a green process alone is insufficient. 中文：消息队列中断时数据库仍保存业务事实，待发事件留在发件箱；恢复连接后检查重试、积压和重复投递处理。
